desc: Derive the fixed-set counting formula (valid subarrays ending at r = r - M(r)) and the deletion-gain characterization (gain = M - second-distinct when max is uniquely owned).

Implement the direct O(n + m) right-endpoint sweep with cnt[] per smaller endpoint, monotonic top-two distinct active smaller endpoints M and S, owner[a] attribution, base = n(n+1)/2 - sum_r M(r), and return base + max(gain).
